objective: Continue the BUKLOD Kingdom premium games workstream: preserve all 13 map stations and original games while implementing Van Sudoku Master and Quin Code Breaker with independently tested deterministic rules and zero economy awards. R3 contains five pilot games total.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: R3 is based exactly on last passed R2 head b745298b5270ffbdc4f040088dfb10eb143487d8, whose Engineering Accountability and Main-side TypeScript+compatibility checks were successful. GitHub main separately advanced to 0fd0d0bd696b8900311c9c835c021f36f6c28f1e with unrelated KL/Word changes. Canonical Kingdom map blob SHA 88a4b1b4a70fc4acd59579419058b47f21be2554 is unchanged. No verified production fingerprint, RC release or OTA is claimed.
chosenApproach: Add a reusable map-preserving KingdomInteriorCenter to the Van/Quin route interiors, retain City Dispatch and Discovery Expedition, and deliver purely local seeded Sudoku and Code Breaker state engines, bilingual accessible controls and preview-only records.
selectionRationale: Pure tested puzzle logic with unique Sudoku solutions and legal Code Breaker feedback lowers regression and bandwidth risks; same existing Kingdom game stage and route IDs avoid native, ad, economy and map modifications.
alternativeApproaches: Replace all 13 station games with a monolithic new engine and downloadable binaries; rejected due to regression, startup size, security and APK compatibility risks.
Deploy 39 separate web applications; rejected as an initial solution due to inconsistent Android ad/audio/offline experiences and large integration burden.
Selected: shared Kingdom game platform with incremental playable interior games and strict no-economy pilot records.
preserveBehaviors: Keep canonical 13-station Kingdom Map and IDs, art, navigation, profiles and original character routes unchanged.
Keep Christian Leadership Council available at its existing route.
Do not change Character V2, Circle Rank, payouts or existing ad sensitive-route protections.
Do not touch native v28 runtime, BUKLOD Empire or production release.
Preserve all 13 original game implementations and Kingdom map; protect previous 3 pilots from route/controller regressions.
acceptanceChecks: 13 center / 39-game uniqueness and status contracts, plus 15 bilingual question and reference contracts.
Exact Kingdom Map git blob SHA matches verified source and old 13 station route paths remain.
Bible Crown is playable and does not grant any client Character Points.
Player sessions saved locally with account-scoped storage and deduplicated receipts.
Engineering regression gate, TypeScript, character/game release checks and physical Android/web acceptance before release.
R2 Block Forge must reject illegal placements, clear completed rows/columns simultaneously and preserve prior board state.
R2 Word Search must generate three deterministic solvable puzzles with all 15 word placements accessible forwards/backwards, and block repeated claims.
Existing Christian Leadership Council and Mitch Restore the Mural must remain selectable in original station routes.
Three Sudoku puzzles must each have exactly one solution, stable seeds and immutable legal entry; fixed cells cannot be overwritten, mistakes tracked.
Three Code Breaker stages must have unique secrets, validate non-repeating digits, return correct exact/displaced clues and enforce bounded guesses.
Van City Dispatch and Quin Discovery Expedition retain their original game components and completion callback; no rewards RPC or ad interruptions.
